raw_segments.text: Clytemnestra. Last night, when first the fiery courier came, in sign that Troy is tan and
raised to earth, so wild a cry of joy my lips gave out, that I was chidden, hath the beacon
watch made sure unto thy soul the sack of Troy. A very woman thou, whose heart leaps
light at wandering rumors, and with words like these they showed me how I strayed, misled
Yet on each shrine I set the sacrifice, and in the strain they held for feminine went
heralds throw the city, to and fro, with voice of loud proclaim announcing joy, and
in each feign they lit and quenched with wine the spicy perfumes fading in the flame. All
is fulfilled. I spare your longer tale, the king himself anon shall tell me all.
